events.name: GXY BANDWAGON - BANDED
events.summary: Our weekday banded social event.  Five events Monday-Friday at the same time.
events.description:
EVENT DESCRIPTION

Our weekday banded social event.  Five events Monday-Friday at the same time.

These events will be time or course based with a 15 minute after party or cool down at the end of the regular event. 

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- E
Power 	- 1.0 > 5.0wkg you decide, just keep pedalling!
Fence 	- No 
Draft	- Banded draft, designed to keep the group together whatever power is generated by a rider
Sweeper 	- No 

We at GXY are committed to creating a culture of belonging, inclusivity and compassion empowering people to grow stronger, work together and support one another to achieve shared success on Zwift

GXY – Here together, for you 💜

If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or both, please come and join ideally via our Facebook link:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/galaxycyclingclub/
https://www.strava.com/clubs/989894
https://www.instagram.com/galaxycyclingclub

events.name: GXY LOOSEY GOOSEY
events.summary: Part of the GOOSEY trilogy of events Tue / Wed / Thu at the same time
events.description:
Part of the GOOSEY trilogy of events Tue / Wed / Thu at the same time

This is the mid powered GOOSEY event, faster than Tue but a slower event than Thu.
Expect a fun, social, steady state ride / event where sprints and Kom segments may be included and staying in the draft is essential.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- D
Power 	- 1.6 > 2.0wkg but expect the event to finish around 1.8wkg based on a 75kg rider.
Fence 	- Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion
Draft	- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group
Sweeper 	- Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name

events.description:
EVENT DESCRIPTION

Part of the SURGE group of events, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday at the same time.  

This event brings a different workout structure each of the four days of the week.  This may include power pyramids, intervals and chase strategies.  Expect a fun social event where sprints and Kom segments may be included.
